My dear [Mr Moor](/person/1046)
I enclose the £1 I fancied I had heard that [Miss Le Gallais](/person/855) had made her start in life.
Will you tell [Selina](/person/1048) that I am sending on the magazine today[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Moor\'s daughter Selina seems to have been the editor of a magazine, perhaps the Ampfield Parish Magazine.
